name: Royal Beluga Azerbaijan
description: Beluga caviar is the most sought-after of all types of caviar - a traditionally elite delicacy with a pronounced nutty taste. The caviar pearls are soft and delicate, 4+ mm in size, colored anthracite to steel gray, taste wonderfully creamy and literally melt in the mouth. Beluga (lat. Huso huso) is the largest fish of the sturgeon family, in the good old days, fishermen caught fish up to five meters long and weighing 1000 kg. The caviar hive was up to 200 kg. Such giants are rarely found in aquaculture. 100 kg heavy specimens are the rule. Beluga females spawn for the first time in 15-20 years, so caviar is the rarest and most expensive. Beluga caviar is best enjoyed neat with a glass of champagne. Ideal for special occasions or as an unforgettable gift.

Unlock a world of delectable possibilities for your palate with every drizzle of this impeccable crab sauce.

name: Lightly Salted Tugunok
description: Discover the exquisite taste of lightly salted tugun. This delicacy, caught in the pure waters of northern rivers, is a true treasure of Russian cuisine. Our tugun is carefully processed according to traditional recipes, preserving its tender texture and unique flavor. Each serving of this fish is not only a source of protein but also vitamins and minerals, making it both delicious and nutritious. Lightly salted tugun is perfect for sophisticated appetizers, slices, or can be the main ingredient in salads and hot dishes. Ingredient: tugunok fish, cold-pressed olive oil, black pepper, salt. name: Cod liver
description: Experience the rich, buttery flavor of our premium cod liver, a sought-after delicacy known for its smooth texture and numerous health benefits. Harvested from the cold, pristine waters, our cod liver is gently processed to retain its natural flavors and nutritional value. Packed with omega-3 fatty acids, vitamin A, and vitamin D, cod liver is not only a tasty treat but also a powerhouse of nutrients that support overall health and wellness. Enjoy it straight from the tin with a touch of sea salt for a classic experience, or incorporate it into salads, spreads, and gourmet dishes to add a touch of luxury. Our cod liver is perfect for those looking to indulge in a delicious, health-boosting delicacy that has been cherished across cultures for its rich taste and health-promoting properties.

name: Pike Caviar
description: Delve into the exquisite delicacy of our pike roe, a true gourmet treasure renowned for its delicate flavor and fine texture. Harvested from the freshest pikes, our roe is meticulously processed to preserve the natural, subtle taste that makes this product so special. Pike roe is celebrated for its bright, appealing color and creamy consistency, making it a standout addition to any dish. It's particularly rich in omega-3 fatty acids and essential nutrients, offering a healthy boost alongside its culinary delights. Enjoy it as a sophisticated topping on canapés, blended into sauces for an elegant pasta dish, or simply on its own to appreciate its refined taste. Our pike roe promises an unmatched flavor experience that elevates any meal into a festive occasion.

name: Sockeye Salmon Fillet "Frozen"
description: Cold-smoked sockeye salmon fillet with skin is a gourmet delicacy with a rich flavor and unique aroma. Sockeye, known for its firm, bright red flesh, undergoes a cold-smoking process that imparts a delicate smoky taste while preserving its natural nutritional benefits. The skin helps maintain the structure of the fillet, making it perfect for slicing. This product is rich in omega-3 fatty acids, vitamins, and antioxidants, making it not only delicious but also healthy. It’s an excellent choice for festive table settings or for creating exquisite appetizers.

name: Kamchatka Red King Crab Legs "Frozen"
description: Frozen red king crab legs are a true delicacy for seafood connoisseurs. Their meat, known for its tenderness and slightly sweet flavor, is a gourmet delight that will satisfy even the most demanding palates. Immediately after being caught, the legs are flash-frozen to preserve their natural juiciness and aroma. These crab legs offer a unique culinary experience, perfectly suited for sophisticated dishes or as the main ingredient for a festive dinner. Freezing at the peak of freshness ensures that each dish will be rich in the pure, robust flavor of the sea. They will not only serve as an exquisite decoration for your table but also provide a memorable taste experience that will leave lasting impressions.

name: Kamchatka Red King Сrab Merus "Frozen"
description: Savor the luxury of the ocean depths with our Kamchatka crab — the first phalanx, shell-free. This exquisite delicacy is sourced from wild, sustainably caught crabs that thrive in the pure, cold waters of Kamchatka. The crab meat is tender and has a distinctive flavor that will satisfy even the most discerning gourmets. A rich source of pure protein, it is ideal for a healthy diet. The first phalanx is already shell-free, which significantly simplifies cooking and reduces kitchen time. Suitable for steaming, grilling, or adding to salads and main dishes. We recommend serving with lemon juice or a delicate cream sauce to fully enhance the flavor.

name: Magadan Shrimp "Frozen"
description: Discover the unparalleled taste of the Far Eastern delicacy with our Magadan shrimp. Caught in the cold, nutrient-rich waters of the Sea of Okhotsk, these shrimp are known for their tender yet rich flavor and delicate texture. They are a true gem among seafood and recognized as one of the best in the world. Our Magadan shrimp are prepared and frozen immediately after catch to preserve their natural freshness and nutritional properties. Ideal for connoisseurs, they are suitable for both elegant dishes and home cooking, adding sophistication and flavor to any table. These shrimp can be prepared in various ways: boiled, fried, baked, or as part of soups and salads, allowing everyone to enjoy their unique taste.

name: Magadan Peeled Shrimp "Frozen"
description: Magadan Peeled Frozen Shrimp is a top-quality product harvested from the pure, cold waters of the Sea of Okhotsk. Due to strict quality control at every stage of production and freezing immediately after catch, these shrimp retain all their beneficial properties and freshness. They are already peeled and ready to use, making them convenient for a variety of dishes, whether it be salads, pastas, risottos, soups, or appetizers. The shrimp are rich in protein, vitamins, and minerals, making them beneficial for your health.

name: Сoal Сod Medallions "Frozen"
description: Discover culinary delight with our frozen Сoal Сod medallions! These exquisite pieces of fish from the salmon family offer a rich flavor and remarkable texture. We select only the freshest fish for freezing to ensure high quality and the preservation of all beneficial properties. High-quality Сoal Сod, sourced from pristine waters Conveniently sized medallions ideal for portioned cooking Quick freezing preserves maximum freshness and nutritional value High in omega-3 fatty acids, beneficial for cardiovascular health Excellent taste and texture, perfect for grilling, baking, and sautéing Medallions can be cooked straight from frozen. Ideal for: Friendly dinners, festive occasions, and everyday meals where taste and quality matter Try our Сoal Сod medallions to enjoy a unique flavor and experience the pleasure of healthy eating!

name: Scallop "Frozen"
description: Frozen scallops are a refined seafood product known for their distinctive taste and high nutritional value. These marine delicacies are harvested in clean waters, where they grow and gain weight, developing their characteristic soft and tender texture. Each scallop is quickly frozen after being caught, preserving its freshness, aroma, and nutritional properties. Frozen scallops are a versatile ingredient, suitable for creating luxurious gourmet dishes as well as simple home recipes. They are easy to cook, maintaining their sophistication and rich flavor. Scallops can be prepared in various ways: sautéed, baked, grilled, or added to soups and stews. Their meat pairs well with a wide range of spices and sauces, making them an ideal choice for culinary experiments and enriching your table with unique and delicious dishes. 12-16 pieces per package.

name: Nelma lightly salted slices
description: Tender nelma fillet lightly salted — melts in your mouth, revealing delicate sweetness and silky texture. A Siberian delicacy in an elegant 300 g slice.

name: Halibut cold-smoked slices
description: Exquisite cold-smoked halibut — ultra-thin slices of snow-white fillet with a velvety, elastic texture. A delicate smoky aroma, light saltiness, and the natural sweetness of the ocean depths. A premium delicacy in perfect slicing, 300 g.
